name: task_beacon_lighthouse
why: Plain white day-mark with no bands, dark lamp room and gallery rail, laminated ply edges on the snow rocks read clearly.

name: task_bells_tower
why: Cleanest ply cladding and louvred belfry, snow ledges carry the laminated ply lines, five dark windows ready for code lighting.

name: task_bells_trio
why: Three clearly separated neutral bells with laminated rim bands and ply yokes, even light for the colour tint.

name: task_lanterns_lantern
why: Four slender bars and empty pale glass give the flame a clear chamber; laminated band matches the Keeper lantern family.

name: task_loyly_kiuas
why: Regenerated wide (art/plan_b3_retry.json) because all plan variants came out nearly square and would draw 1.5x taller; this one is 1.61 wide like the current 1.51, firebox door near x 0.3, y 0.65 for the code embers.

name: task_fireflies_jar
why: Glass has the most legible flat highlights over the dark backdrop, laminated birch lid and wire clasp are crisp.

name: task_fork_cairn
why: Gently leaning five-stone column with the clearest felt cord and laminated snow edges, strongest silhouette at prop size.

name: task_lanterns_pier_rope
why: Smoothest single catenary with wrapped rope ends on both posts and a laminated deck edge.

name: task_loyly_bucket
why: Laminated rim and hoops are the most refined, ice water reads just over the rim.

name: task_loyly_ladle
why: Deepest bowl at the left with soft value modelling and laminated rim, most readable as a ladle at small size.

name: task_reaction_light_fish
why: Plumpest, calmest char facing right with veneer fins; best friendly silhouette for the Bite glow.

name: task_shutters_facade
why: Every window has closed pale shutters as the task needs, muted ply, frost and ceiling green walls, laminated snow roofs, transparent above the roofs.

name: task_threads_loom_frame
why: Band about 8 percent wide with visible ply layers, empty opening, gentler shadow than v3.

name: task_beacon_boat
why: Raised prow to the right, laminated gunwale, white wheelhouse with dark window, no warm stripes.

name: task_beacon_ferry
why: Cleanest superstructure, no life ring or red, frost funnel and ply rubbing strake read at a glance.

name: task_beacon_pier_lanterns
why: Five evenly spaced unlit lanterns, both ends cut at identical heights so the seam matches.

name: task_fireflies_reeds
why: Fullest reed tufts with ply seed heads framing a clear ice band; drawn once in code so tiling is not needed.

name: task_fork_waymarker_sheet
why: Markers centred in equal halves, cold and warm versions differ only by the felted ply band as specified.

name: task_reaction_splash_sheet
why: Four equal columns on one baseline with the clearest ring, crown, peak and fall sequence.

name: task_shutters_dawn_view
why: Honey sun with a soft reflection column, laminated snow fells and the calmest lilac-to-apricot sky.

name: task_stars_sky
why: Smoothest gradient with the least pink at the horizon, faint stars only, spruce fringe low.

name: task_beacon_sea
why: Layered veneer swells with the strongest depth toward the bottom and a near-perfect left-right seam.

name: task_fireflies_firefly_sheet
why: Readable up, level, down, level wingbeat in four equal columns with a visible honey tail.
